# Mano Ranjan Narayanasamy

> Agent-ready versions of my articles on coding agents, Claude Code and AI engineering. Each link is plain markdown with an "Apply this" section an agent can follow. Read a page before handing it to your agent: every page names the files it changes and asks the agent to show the diff first.

## Articles

- [How to stop Claude Code from hitting your limit and forgetting why](https://manosec.github.io/blog/claude-code-context.md): Set up .claude/rules/decisions.md and Compact instructions so decisions survive /compact and sessions stay short. (checked 2026-10-29)
